title: Screening report v0.1 (selective lane)
description: The triage document for the source-grounded selective lane. It differs from screening_report.schema.json in exactly two ways: preliminary_assessment is not required (the lane makes no feasibility/difficulty/payout judgement), and the operational sections the lane produces -- the required-document checklist, whether a disability assessment already exists, and what the records could not establish -- are declared rather than riding along undeclared. The legacy contract is unchanged and still governs the legacy lane.

report_path.description: Path to the rendered .md report. outputs/CASE_XXX/screening_report.md

source_denial_contract_hash.description: SHA-256 of the denial_reason_result.json this report summarizes -- of the reason ids, decision types, taxonomy codes, and owned policy_match_ids, not the whole file. The DAO recomputes it from the contract on disk at write time and refuses a mismatch, so a screening report describing a superseded reason set cannot be persisted. Rewriting denial_reason_result.json flips this stage back to pending in run-state; no file is deleted.

unconfirmed_items.description: Fields the run could not establish. Each carries the STRUCTURED cause alongside the sentence: an unconstrained `{type: object}` here is how the cause went unpublished until 2026-08-21 -- nothing failed when it was absent.

unavailable_reason.$comment: Mirrors claim_analysis_result#/$defs/field_result/unavailable_reason; nullable because a pre-2026-08-21 result may not carry one.

gap_kind.description: What a reader can DO about it. Only `records_gap` is closable by requesting documents; `not_searched` says the pipeline never looked and why. `partial_reading` is neither: the document exists, was read, and states a value that failed the trusted-value bar (incomplete or ambiguous), so more records would add nothing -- a person must read the quote the contract already carries and decide whether it is the whole answer.

policy_links.description: Copied from `claim_analysis_result.policy_links`. Present so section 8 of the narrative and the evidence sidecar can name the clauses the case actually links to; previously the report dropped them and the section read '연결된 약관 조항 없음' on every case.

case_summary.description: Case overview section. Source: extracted_claim_fields, coverage_result, case_type_result.

case_type.description: Case type -- e.g. permanent-disability, diagnosis/surgery-cost, out-of-pocket medical, liability, other. See pipeline.md's taxonomy.

claim_coverages.description: Standard coverage names -- see pipeline.md's taxonomy.

insurer_position.description: Insurer's determination section. Source: denial_reason_result (from denial-response, consumed as a dependency -- see pipeline.md).

has_denial_or_reduction.description: Deprecated compatibility field retained for one schema version. Must equal has_denial OR has_reduction; consumers should migrate to the two explicit fields.

has_acceptance.description: Whether the insurer's response ACCEPTED any coverage. Optional and additive: absent means the report predates this field, NOT that nothing was accepted. Without it a split outcome was structurally invisible -- CASE_907's report correctly said in prose that 배상책임 was denied while 구내치료비 ₩2,000,000 was notified, but insurer_position read has_denial:true/has_reduction:false and nothing else, which a structural consumer takes as a total denial. That is the exact misreading denial_reason_result's accepted_coverages exists to prevent, so the report that summarizes it must carry the axis too.

acceptance.description: Which coverages the insurer accepted, mirroring the denial/reduction summaries. Sourced from denial_reason_result.accepted_coverages; ids must be exactly that contract's accepted_coverage_ids.

total_amount.description: Sum of stated accepted amounts, or null when no figure is stated. An amount the insurer merely NOTIFIED is still recorded here -- payment_status on the source contract carries whether it was actually paid, and this field must never be read as proof of payment.

evidence_references.description: What the insurer itself wrote, copied from the denial contract. Empty when the response stated no locatable grounds -- never a licence to supply one.

summary.description: Summary of the insurer's position -- hedged, non-definitive phrasing.

total_amount.description: Total denied or reduced amount when explicitly available; null when the source does not state enough amounts to total safely.

evidence_references.description: What the insurer itself wrote, copied from the denial contract. Empty when the response stated no locatable grounds -- never a licence to supply one.

inconsistency.description: A cross-document inconsistency. Source: evidence_validation_result / the conflict ledger (see harness-guardrails P6) -- detailed doc_a/doc_b value comparison and resolution live there; this is a summary plus document tracing.

conflict_ref.description: The conflict-ledger entry this inconsistency carries, when it came from there. Required in practice for every entry the ledger marks `deferred_to_report`: finalize-stage screening_report refuses unless each such conflict_id appears here, which is what makes a deferral a carried obligation rather than a second way of saying `resolved`. Optional on an inconsistency the report raises on its own, which has no ledger entry to point at. Bind by id, not by matching prose -- CASE_047's four deferrals were described in the report body in fluent Korean that no string comparison could have tied back to CONFLICT_1..4.

related_documents.description: The documents being compared where the inconsistency was found.

missing_document.description: A document recommended for follow-up request.

document_type.description: Standard code or specific document name. e.g. disability_certificate

review_point.description: A point flagged for expert review. This array is P3's aggregation point for Phase 1: P3 says an inference-bearing claim is hedged and flagged, does not halt its stage, and that flagged claims 'surface together at the aggregation/report stage for batch human review' -- screening-report is that stage, and these are those claims. v0.3 adds point_id, source_refs and answerable, all optional so every pre-2026-08-06 report validates untouched.

point_id.description: Stable identifier, RP-N, numbered within this report. Its absence was a real asymmetry: critic findings carry finding_id and expert_review disposes of each by finding_ref, so a human's answer to a critic has somewhere to attach -- while a review point had no id at all, leaving a reviewer's answer with nothing to bind to and no way to tell later which points were ever addressed. Number stably; a point that survives into a later revision keeps its id.

reviewer_role.description: Who can actually answer THIS question -- routed per question, not copied from the flagging contract's own reviewer_role. Those differ in practice and the per-question value is the correct one: on CASE_909 every upstream contract-level flag read 손해사정사, while the questions behind them split 법률전문가 4 / 손해사정사 5 / 의사 1. Whether a McBride rating is medically sound is a 의사 question no matter which contract raised it.

source_refs.description: Where this point came from: the upstream contract(s) whose review_required flag, uncertainty, or warning it aggregates. Prose naming of a source is not enough -- on CASE_909, 5 of 10 points named no document and none was machine-resolvable, so nothing could check whether a flagged contract had been surfaced at all. Empty is legitimate for a point the agent raised from its own reading rather than from an upstream flag.

answerable.description: Whether a reviewer can change anything by answering. False marks a point raised for the record over material that is simply gone -- a value erased by redaction, a document absent from the pack -- where 'please confirm this is missing' spends expert attention and returns nothing. Default true when omitted. This is what keeps batch review from filling with unanswerable items: prefer raising the DOWNSTREAM CONSEQUENCE as an answerable point instead (CASE_909 routed a redaction-blanked 사고일자 as the premise of 보험기간 내 사고 여부 and 소멸시효, not as 'a field is null').

review_point_source.description: An upstream contract this review point aggregates, and optionally the element within it.

contract.description: Filename of the upstream contract, e.g. requirement_matching_result.json or denial_reason_result.json.

element_id.description: The specific element inside that contract when one applies -- REQ-3, DR_1, PM_2, CONFLICT_1. Null when the flag is contract-level.

preliminary_assessment.description: DEPRECATED in the selective lane. feasibility and difficulty are forecasts the lane does not make -- placed beside evidenced facts in a practitioner's briefing they read with the same weight, and nothing in the records supports them. Present only for compatibility with consumers of the legacy contract; when it appears, the helper writes the not_assessed constants and no agent judgement contributes to it.

rationale_evidence_references.description: Evidence backing this assessment. Empty is treated as source_grounded: false.

draft_writer_input_summary.description: Summary handed to draft-report. template_id is decided by case-type classification.

screening_evidence_reference.description: One exact citation carried forward from an upstream contract. The screening report never mints these: each is copied from the claim analysis result, the denial contract, or the conflict ledger entry that already established it, so a quote here resolves in the processed text exactly as it did there.

fact_evidence.description: Per-fact evidence for the case summary's scalar values. Keyed by the summary field it grounds (accident_date, main_diagnosis, kcd_code, treatment_period), so a section that prints a value can carry exactly the citation for that value and no other.

additionalProperties.description: Exact upstream evidence for the value(s) this entry states. An empty array means the records did not establish it -- never that a citation was omitted, and never a licence to invent one.

conflict_candidate_ids.description: Conflict candidate ids from the claim analysis result, carried unchanged. They are the link between a requirement and the disagreement a reviewer must judge it against.

evidence_references.description: Exact upstream evidence for the value(s) this entry states. An empty array means the records did not establish it -- never that a citation was omitted, and never a licence to invent one.

screening_policy_link.description: One coverage term linked to the policy layer that `policy_clause_processing` already built. A link says which clause the claim would be assessed against; it never states that the claim is covered, and this report adds no coverage or payout verdict of its own.

clause_ref.description: Present only for `matched`. A candidate or not_found link carries `uncertainty_reason` instead, because naming a clause it could not confirm is the fabricated reference this lane refuses.
